source_title: Dragon Ball: 6 Strongest Power Limiter Forms, Ranked
source_excerpt:
Renan is the Anime Lead Editor for GameRant. Ren graduated Cum Laude from Lesley University in 2017 and has been focusing exclusively on his journalistic endeavors ever since. When Ren isn't working, he's usually playing video games or reading.
Dragon Ball is all about breaking one's limits. From the very beginning, Goku has been training and fighting non-stop to set new records and prove that he can achieve quite literally anything. Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball Super doubled down on this idea by canonizing the notion that Saiyans are a race known for breaking their limits.
Naturally, Dragon Ball has its fair share of Power Limiter forms that keep characters from reaching their full potential – at least not without some work. The strongest Power Limiter forms in Dragon Ball are only one step away from turning into the most powerful transformations in anime history and already plenty dangerous without their true upgrades.
6 Super Saiyan A-Type is a Mutation Created By Broly's Ring
Both versions of Broly come equipped with power limiters courtesy of their fathers, but DBZ Broly's crown is the far more interesting device. In Dragon Ball Z: Broly – The Legendary Super Saiyan , Broly's Ring actually creates a mutation within him whenever he tries to turn Super Saiyan. Instead of activating the regular form, Broly switches into Super Saiyan A-Type, a pseudo form that still manages to be quite deadly.
Even with just Super Saiyan A-Type, Broly is able to make the Z-Fighters sweat. The Ring's goal is to prevent Broly from activating Super Saiyan C-Type, his version of SSJ1 and the final step towards becoming a Legendary Super SAiyan in Dragon Ball Z. Power-wise, Super Saiyan A-Type Broly could take out just anyone from the Cell Saga.
The Frost Demons are so strong that they actually need to create new transformations in order to limit their Power Levels. Frieza's final form as fans know it is actually his original and true body. Frieza's first, second, and third forms were actually all developed after the fact so that Frieza could live his life without obliterating everything around him. By all metrics, the same philosophy applies to King Cold and Frieza's older brother Cooler .
By this token, Frieza's Golden form is yet another Power Limiter – this time for Frieza's true Black form. Frieza unlocked Golden after training for four months, a fact Goku rightfully chastised him about. Learning from his mistake, Frieza ends up finidng a Hyperbolic Time Chamber in the Dragon Ball Super manga, trains for a full decade, and does not leave until he mutates Golden Frieza into Black Frieza. His hard work paid off as Black Frieza is currently the single strongest mortal in the franchise.
4 Wrathful Harnesses Great Ape Power Into Broly's Base Form
Dragon Ball Super: Broly made the titular Saiyan and his Legendary Super Saiyan form canon after decades of being locked away in DBZ movies and spin-offs, but it also brought with it an entirely new transformation. Almost like Dragon Ball Super 's version of GT 's Golden Great Ape form, Wrathful is the first step for Broly to become a Legendary Super Saiyan.
By harnessing all the power of an Oozaru into his base form, Broly taps into Wrathful – a transformation powerful enough to allow him to fight evenly with Super Saiyan Blue Goku. In a sense, Wrathful foreshadows Broly eventually unlocking True Legendary Super Saiyan in the Dragon Ball Super manga, showing that he can control an urge even as primal as becoming a Great Ape.
3 Ultra Instinct Sign is the First Step To Obtaining Angelic Power
During the Tournament of Power, Goku's training under Whis finally paid off when he triggered Ultra Instinct Sign. An Angelic form that can only be accessed by master martial artists and the greatest fighters alive, Ultra Instinct is the ultimate transformation – but Sign is only one step towards greatness. If the user's mental state and heart are not properly calm, Ultra Instinct will cap itself at its Sign variant, an in-between form that offers Godlike reflexes, but a minimal power boost.
Goku is able to get more power out of Ultra Instinct Sign the longer he uses it – at least in the Dragon Ball Super anime – but it's nothing compared to the full might of Perfected Ultra Instinct. PUI is a straight upgrade of Sign, offering a huge power, speed, defense, and stamina upgrade. Ultra Instinct Sign is useful in a pinch, but as seen in Dragon Ball Super , it wasn't even powerful enough to take out Jiren.
2 Inner Nature Unleashed is the Heeter Clan's Answer to Legendary Super Saiyan
The Heeters are one of the most dangerous species in Universe 7. Like Frost Demons , Heeters are actually so powerful, they need to find way to hold back their full strength. Unlike Frieza's family, who developed transformations to suppress their overwhelming energy, the Heeters use crowns, ala Broly's Ring from Dragon Ball Z to keep themselves in check. Similar to Broly, a Heeter at full power risks going insane and losing control of their body.
This is exactly what happens to Gas in the Granolah the Survivor Saga. Witt their limiter broken, a Heeter can awaken their Inner Nature Unleashes form, which grants a massive boost in both power and speed. Inner Nature Unleashed Gas is one of the strongest warriors in Universe 7, and second only to his fully Awakened form – which is essentially just INU, but with Gas now able to actually control his mind and body.
1 Legendary Super Saiyan is Incomplete If the User Can't Control Themselves
Dragon Ball Super 's version of Legendary Super Saiyan is the strongest Power Limiter form in the series, if only because of how much effort it took to take Broly down. Not even Super Saiyan Blue Goku and Vegeta working together was enough to so much as hurt Broly. Even then, Gogeta wasn't able to deal any damage whatsoever (even flinching to a punch from Broly) until he began using Super Saiyan Blue.
The most powerful fusion in Dragon Ball Super still needed a God form to fight Legendary Super Saiyan Broly. As revealed in the Dragon Ball Super manga, LSSJ still has one more tier to unlock. True Legendary Super Saiyan not only grants the user a greater boost than regular LSSJ, the user can actually control themselves. Broly finally awakens True Legendary Super Saiyan while sparring with Gohan Beast in Dragon Ball Super Chapter 103.
